epigraph: Unsure if this is a census or a warning.
pro_text: Patch has always been comfortable with things that don’t make sense. This has never caused him any problems.
con_text: Patch occasionally misses contextual warnings — NPC fear expressions, audio cues, environmental danger signals. The game assumes he noticed. He didn’t always.
mechanics_note: No pro/con mechanic is implemented - this file is selection-screen text and starting state only. The effects described are design commitments from Docs/03_MECHANICS.md, each owned by the phase that builds its system. pro_text is the Docs/03 obfuscated selection-screen wording (spoiler protection); pro_text_hidden is the real pro and is never shown on the selection screen. Docs/03 balance note: Pro has RNG component (doesn’t always trigger cleanly) AND Patch occasionally misreads hostile NPCs as neutral. High risk / high reward starting village. Exception: the shortened stagger is built (session 7, WEIRDNESS_SPEC §5/M-5); the missed-warning con belongs to combat (phase 5).
pro_text_hidden: Patch skips paralysis on first contact with overt world-break events. No stagger animation, faster return to player control. Compounds significantly in late game.
